meta.name: tts-error-reporting
meta.description: Convention for reporting errors from multiprocessing TTS workers to the main process frontend. Use this skill when modifying, adding, or debugging TTS workers in tts_client.py to ensure connection errors, quotas, and API limits correctly display Toast notifications to the user rather than failing silently.

copy.tagline: 确保TTS多进程工作器的错误正确显示为前端通知
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在开发或维护TTS客户端，需要确保错误不被静默忽略
copy.tagline_en: Ensure TTS multiprocessing worker errors display as frontend notifications correctly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing or maintaining a TTS client and need to ensure errors are not silently ignored

howto.what: 安装此技能后，Claude 在修改或调试 TTS 工作器时，会确保错误通过 response_queue 发送，并触发前端 Toast 通知，而非静默失败。
howto.when: 当你要求修改、添加或调试 tts_client.py 中的 TTS 工作器时，或者当 TTS 服务遇到配额、API 或连接错误时。

say.text: 请帮我添加一个新的 TTS 工作器，并确保错误报告正确。
say.note: Claude 会自动遵循错误报告协议。

say.text: 检查我这段 TTS 代码，是否按约定报告了错误？
修复这个 TTS 工作器，使其在 API 故障时通知用户。
say.note: Claude 会添加错误报告逻辑并生成 Toast 通知。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, when modifying or debugging TTS workers, Claude ensures errors are sent via response_queue and displayed as Toast notifications to the user, instead of failing silently.
howto.when_en: When you ask to modify, add, or debug TTS workers in tts_client.py, or when TTS services encounter quota, API, or connection errors.

say_en.text: Please add a new TTS worker with proper error reporting.
say_en.note: Claude will follow the error reporting protocol automatically.

say_en.text: Check my TTS code for correct error reporting.
say_en.note: Claude will inspect if response_queue.put(("__error__", ...)) is used.

say_en.text: Fix this TTS worker to notify user on API failure.
say_en.note: Claude will add error reporting logic and trigger a Toast.
